A brand-new AI model has just been released! 🚀

Support Me: https://www.buymeacoffee.com/codewithyousaf

Tencent Hunyuan has released Hy4 Preview, a new open-source AI model with:
🔥 770B Total Parameters
⚡ 49B Active Parameters
🧠 1M+ Context Window
💻 Built for Coding & Productivity
📊 Office, Research, Frontend & Game Development

The exciting part is that Hy4 Preview is now available on WorkBuddy for a limited 14-day period.

In this video, I show you how to access Hy4 Preview and test its capabilities with real-world AI agent workflows, including research, frontend development, and game development.

Also, Hy3 access has been extended until September 30.

Try Hy4 Preview and let me know in the comments what you think about this new model!
